inputs.title: Enterprise Sales Pipeline Briefing Team
inputs.expected_demo_behavior: A ranked opportunity brief identifies the top account, supporting signals, risks, and next seller action
inputs.holdout_policy: Private cases vary account completeness, contradictory buying signals, and score ties without exposing expected rankings to the team.

inputs.title: Production Incident Command Team
inputs.expected_demo_behavior: The selector consults only relevant specialists and returns a severity, evidence summary, mitigation, and escalation owner
inputs.holdout_policy: Private cases vary the failing subsystem, ambiguous alerts, and missing telemetry while preserving the same severity and authority rules.

inputs.title: Insurance Claims Resolution Swarm
inputs.expected_demo_behavior: The claim follows the intake-to-specialist-to-settlement path with an auditable coverage decision and no unauthorized payment
inputs.holdout_policy: Private cases change coverage clauses, fraud indicators, and evidence quality; workers receive only assertion identifiers and redacted failure feedback.

inputs.title: Regulated Proposal Refinement Team
inputs.expected_demo_behavior: A materially improved proposal passes evidence and risk review within the bounded attempt budget
inputs.holdout_policy: Private cases inject unsupported claims, conflicting requirements, and subtle authority violations without disclosing the hidden defect locations.

inputs.title: Customer Renewal Orchestration Team
inputs.expected_demo_behavior: The workflow reads the account, obtains a candidate meeting slot, creates a draft-only outreach artifact, and records idempotent evidence
inputs.holdout_policy: Private cases vary duplicate triggers, stale CRM data, calendar conflicts, and provider timeouts while keeping credentials and expected recovery traces private.
